## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, pairing codes, cookies, private hostnames, generated
      artifacts, release bundles, or updater private keys are committed.
- [ ] Auth, pairing, credential, executor, MCP, live-link, import/export,
      cleanup, and private-access boundaries are unchanged or tested.
- [ ] Workflow, dependency, Tauri, script, service-worker, license, security,
      or contribution-policy changes are called out for owner review.
- [ ] Docs and ledgers are updated when implementation status changed.
